# BookPals

> A reading-community platform. Users get matched with similar readers, join
> genre communities, chat in real time, and discover new books through people
> with shared taste.

BookPals is a web application gated behind account sign-up - most pages
require authentication and are not publicly crawlable content. The pages
below are the public surface.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://bookpals.app/): what BookPals is and how it works
- [Sign up](https://bookpals.app/signup): create an account
- [Log in](https://bookpals.app/login): sign in to an existing account
